Rashi on Keritot 5b:10:1.hebrew: ומפני מחלוקתו של יורם נמשח כו' - דבשלמא מלך בן מלך דבית דוד, כי איכא מחלוקת, נפקא לן מקראי דהדר למילתיה קמייתא למשיחה, אבל מלכי ישראל לא חזו למשיחה כלל:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:10:1.english: And due to the dispute with Joram he was anointed, etc. - For granted, [in the case of] a king [who is] the son of a king of the House of David, when there is a dispute, we derive from verses that it reverts to its original state regarding anointing; but kings of Israel are not fit for anointing at all.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:10:2.english: With pure balsam - [He] was anointed, and not with the anointing oil.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:11:1.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr> [ואמר רבי] יוחנן הוא יהואחז, צדקיהו הוא שלום:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:11:1.english: This is the reading: [And Rabbi] Yoḥanan [said]: He [Johanan] is Jehoahaz; Zedekiah is Shallum.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:13:1.english: But it counts [them] in a row - For [the verse] counts "third" and "fourth".

Rashi on Keritot 5b:13:2.hebrew: דמלך יכניהו - בן יהויקים, תחת יהויקים אביו, קמי צדקיהו:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:13:2.english: Because Jeconiah reigned - [He was] the son of Jehoiakim, [and reigned] in place of Jehoiakim his father, before Zedekiah.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:17:1.hebrew: שנאמר ואת כלי הזהב וגו' - מדכתיב "בארגז מצדו", אלמא כל היכא דהוי ארון הוי ארגז בהדיה, וכי איגניז, איגניז בהדיה:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:17:1.english: As it is stated: "And the jewels of gold, etc." - Since it is written "in a coffer by its side," [this proves] that wherever the Ark was, the coffer was with it; and when [the Ark] was sequestered, [the coffer] was sequestered with it.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:17:2.hebrew: תנו את הארון - בבית אשר בנה שלמה, כי אין לכם משא בכתף. וגרסינן במסכת שקלים (פ"ו ה"א): אמר להם, אם גלה עמכם לבבל, שוב אין אתם מחזירין אותו בכתפיכם, וגנזו:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:17:2.english: Put the Ark - in the house that Solomon built, for you have no burden upon the shoulder. And we learn in Tractate Shekalim (6:1): He said to them, "If it goes into exile with you to Babylonia, you will never again bring it back upon your shoulders," and [therefore] he sequestered it.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:18:1.hebrew: צנצנת אתיא שמה שמה - כתיב בארון (שמות ל׳:ו׳) אשר אועד לך שמה, ובצנצנת כתיב (שם טז) ותן שמה מלא העומר מן:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:18:1.english: [The] jar [of manna] is derived [from] "there" [shammah], "there" [shammah] - It is written concerning the Ark (Exodus 30:6), "where I will meet with you there [shammah]," and concerning the jar it is written (ibid. 16), "and put there [shammah] an omer-full of manna."

Rashi on Keritot 5b:19:1.english: And the anointing oil is derived [through] “generations” “generations” - From the jar [of manna].

Rashi on Keritot 5b:1:1.hebrew: וכי נס א' נעשה בו - שאתה מתמיה שאינו ספק אפילו לסוך אהרן ובניו כל ז' ימי המלואים, כדמפרש בפ"ק דיומא (דף ה.): "שבעת ימים ימלא את ידכם" (ויקרא ח׳:ל״ג), ואיתקש משיחה לריבוי, דכתיב: "למשחה בהם ולמלא בם את ידם" (שמות כ״ט:כ״ט):
Rashi on Keritot 5b:1:1.english: And was one miracle performed with it - That you wonder that it is not sufficient even to anoint Aaron and his sons [for] all seven days of the inauguration, as it explains in the first chapter of Yoma (5a): "[For] seven days he shall fill your hand [i.e., consecrate you]" (Leviticus 8:33), and anointing is equated with investiture, as it is written: "to be anointed in them, and to fill their hand [i.e., be consecrated] in them" (Exodus 29:29).

Rashi on Keritot 5b:20:1.hebrew: מקלו של אהרן אתיא משמרת משמרת - מצנצנת. כתיב במקל (במדבר י״ז:כ״ה) "למשמרת לאות לבני מרי", בצנצנת "למשמרת לדורותיכם":
Rashi on Keritot 5b:20:1.english: Aaron’s staff is derived [through] “to be kept” [and] “to be kept” - From the jar [of manna]. It is written regarding the staff (Numbers 17:25): “To be kept for a token against the rebellious children,” [and] regarding the jar: “To be kept throughout your generations.”

Rashi on Keritot 5b:21:1.english: Like a crown - Around on his head.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:21:2.hebrew: כמין כי - אות יוונית, ועשוי כזה x, דמציק שמן על ראשו ואח"כ בין ריסי עיניו, ומצרפן באצבעו דרך הפדחת:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:21:2.english: Similar to chi - [It is] a Greek letter, and it is shaped like this: x; for one pours oil upon his head and afterward between his eyelashes, and joins them with his finger along the forehead.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:24:1.hebrew: מספר - מדבר. ל"א מסתפר, דשקיל במזייה:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:24:1.english: Speaks (mesapper) - [This means] he speaks. Another explanation: He cuts [his] hair, [meaning] that he trims his hair.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:24:2.english: Perhaps I misused [the oil] - That I put too much there.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:26:1.english: And I misused [consecrated property] - For my garments derive benefit from the fragrance of the oil that is on my beard.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:27:1.hebrew: גיחון - מעיין קטן סמוך לירושלים, ולא זהו גיחון הגדול היוצא מעדן:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:27:1.english: Gihon - A small spring near Jerusalem, and this is not the great Gihon that flows out of Eden.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:29:1.english: Let him bring a hen - For that purpose.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:2:1.hebrew: זה לי לדורותיכם - אלמא כולהו י"ב לוגין דקיימי לעתיד לבוא:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:2:1.english: This [shall be] to Me throughout your generations - Thus, all twelve log [of oil] remain [intact] for the future to come.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:30:1.english: In a dark house - Somewhat dark.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:4:1.hebrew: יהויקים - היה גדול מיהואחז ב' שנים, דכתיב בו (מלכים ב כ״ג:ל״א): "יהואחז בן עשרים ושלש שנה היה במלכו וג' חדשים מלך", וביהויקים כתיב (שם): "בן עשרים וחמש שנה היה במלכו". נמצא יהויקים גדול מיהואחז ב' שנים. כך שנויה בסדר עולם:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:4:1.english: Jehoiakim - [He] was two years older than Jehoahaz, as it is written concerning him (II Kings 23:31): "Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months"; and concerning Jehoiakim it is written (ibid. [23:36]): "[He was] twenty-five years old when he began to reign." Thus, Jehoiakim is found to be two years older than Jehoahaz. So it is taught in Seder Olam.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:7:1.hebrew: בזמן ששלום בישראל - הוי המלכות ירושה ולא בעי משיחה, אבל כי איכא מחלוקת, לאו ירושה היא ובעי משיחה בתחלה:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:7:1.english: At a time when there is peace in Israel - the kingship is an inheritance and does not require anointing, but when there is a dispute, it is not an inheritance and requires anointing at the outset.

Rashi on Keritot 5b:8:1.hebrew: ולא מלכי ישראל - משבא דוד, אבל שאול נמשח:
Rashi on Keritot 5b:8:1.english: And not the kings of Israel - From when David came [to power]; however, Saul was anointed.
